titulo_es: Notizie ed eventi nella comunità locale

previsti.en: as provided for in the cartel

completamente.en: in a total and absolute way

frases.it: Il Comune organizza la festa del quartiere sabato prossimo in piazza Garibaldi.
frases.es: El Ayuntamiento organiza la fiesta del barrio el próximo sábado en la plaza Garibaldi.
frases.en: The City Council organizes the neighborhood party next Saturday in Garibaldi Square.

frases.it: Sono previsti stand gastronomici, spettacoli musicali e attività per bambini dalle sedici.
frases.es: Están previstos puestos gastronómicos, espectáculos musicales y actividades para niños desde las dieciséis.
frases.en: Gastronomical posts, musical shows and activities for children have been planned since the 16th.

frases.it: Le previsioni del tempo indicano pioggia nel pomeriggio: in caso di maltempo, i concerti si sposteranno nella palestra comunale.
frases.es: Las previsiones del tiempo indican lluvia por la tarde: en caso de mal tiempo, los conciertos se trasladarán al gimnasio municipal.
frases.en: The weather forecasts indicate rain in the afternoon: in the event of bad weather, concerts will be moved to the municipal gym.
analisis: Le previsioni del tempo indicano pioggia

frases.it: Gli stand dei prodotti tipici resteranno riparati sotto i portici del centro storico.
frases.es: Los puestos de productos típicos permanecerán resguardados bajo los soportales del centro histórico.
frases.en: The typical product posts will be kept under the support of the historical center.
analisis: will be kept under the supports

frases.it: L'ingresso all'intera manifestazione è completamente gratuito per tutti i cittadini.
frases.es: La entrada a todo el evento es completamente gratuita para todos los ciudadanos.
frases.en: The entrance to the entire event is completely free for all citizens.
analisis: the entrance to the whole competition

frases.it: Gli organizzatori comunicheranno tempestivamente eventuali modifiche sul sito del Comune entro venerdì sera.
frases.es: Los organizadores comunicarán con prontitud posibles modificaciones en la web municipal antes del viernes por la tarde.
frases.en: The organizers will promptly report possible changes to the municipal website by Friday afternoon.
analisis: the organizers shall give prompt notice
changes that arise on the web

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: management of local festivities, weather contingencies and warnings

bloques.pregunta: What celebration does the city council hold next Saturday in Garibaldi Square?

opciones.texto: The community party of the neighborhood with posts and music.
opciones.explicacion: The release announces: «Il Comune organizza la festa del quartiere sabato prossimo in piazza Garibaldi».

opciones.texto: Un certamen deportivo de atletismo escolar comarcal.
opciones.explicacion: It's not a sports test, it's a neighborhood party.

opciones.texto: Una feria comercial de venta exclusiva de automóviles usados.

bloques.pregunta: What time is the start of activities for children and posts planned?

opciones.explicacion: The text points out exactly: «attività per bambini dalle sedici».
The start is announced for 4: 00 p.m. (16: 00).

opciones.texto: Exclusively at midnight after the nearby dinner.

bloques.pregunta: What action will be taken with the concerts in the event of heavy rain?

opciones.texto: They will move to the covered facilities of the municipal gym.
opciones.explicacion: The notice includes: «in caso di maltempo, i concerti si sposteranno nella palestra comunale».

opciones.texto: Quedarán definitivamente cancelados sin posibilidad de recuperación.
opciones.explicacion: They don't cancel, they move to the gym.

opciones.texto: They will continue in the open in the middle of the square without any protection.

bloques.pregunta: Where will the gastronomic posts be located if the weather conditions get worse?

opciones.texto: Under the protected supports of the historical center.
opciones.explicacion: The instruction confirms: «resteranno riparati sotto i portici del centro storico».

opciones.texto: Inside the plenary room of the city hall.
opciones.explicacion: They are located under the outer supports.

opciones.texto: At the local train station in the neighbouring town.
opciones.explicacion: They remain in the historic area protected.

bloques.pregunta: What is the cost of access to the activities and shows of the party?

opciones.texto: The entrance is completely free and free for all attendees.
opciones.explicacion: The text specifies: «L'ingresso all'intera manifestazione è completamente gratuito».

opciones.texto: It requires a compulsory donation of five euros per family.
opciones.explicacion: It's an open activity without any payment.

opciones.texto: Es gratuita solo para residentes empadronados que muestren carné.
opciones.explicacion: It is open for free for all citizens.

bloques.pregunta: What official channel will make possible changes to the program available?

opciones.texto: On the official City Hall website before Friday night.
opciones.explicacion: The precise information: «comunicheranno eventuali modifiche sul sito del Comune entro venerdì sera».

opciones.texto: By means of megaphony on the commercial streets during the same afternoon.
opciones.explicacion: It will be announced in advance on the institutional website.

opciones.texto: Only on the library's physical ad boards.
opciones.explicacion: It will be published digitally on the municipal website.

bloques.frase: L'ingresso alla festa del quartiere è gratuito
bloques.traduccion: The entrance to the neighborhood party is free
bloques.explicacion: Institutional notification of free access at no cost.

intro: It includes news and municipal communications on cultural activities, alternative plans for bad weather and access.
